description: Check the businesses, nonprofits and governments registered to work with the U.S. government: look an entity up by UEI or CAGE code, see its registration status, expiration date and integrity record, search entities, download extracts, and start a workflow when a registration is about to expire, changes status, or a new one matches a search.

sam_gov_new_entity_trigger.description: Runs when an entity newly registered in SAM.gov matches a search, such as a state and NAICS code. Narrow it to fewer than 30 new registrations a month. Checks twice a day, to stay inside a personal key's 10 requests a day.

output.entity: The entity's registration and core data, as SAM.gov returns them
output.exclusion_status_flag: Y if the entity has an active exclusion
output.public_display_notice: SAM.gov's notice when the entity opted out of public display, else empty
output.purpose_of_registration: Purpose of registration, such as All Awards

sam_gov_registration_expiring_trigger.description: Runs once for each active SAM.gov registration that comes within the chosen number of days of expiring: watched UEIs, or every registration in a state or NAICS code. Checks twice a day, to stay inside a personal key's 10 requests a day.

output.days_left: Days from today until the registration expires
output.entity: The entity's registration and core data, as SAM.gov returns them
output.exclusion_status_flag: Y if the entity has an active exclusion
output.public_display_notice: SAM.gov's notice when the entity opted out of public display, else empty
output.purpose_of_registration: Purpose of registration, such as All Awards

parameters.description: Unique Entity IDs (12 letters and digits each), separated by commas. Up to 100. Leave blank to watch every registration in the state or NAICS code.
parameters.name: ueis

parameters.description: How many days before expiring to run: 7, 14, 30 (the default), 60 or 90.
parameters.name: days_ahead

parameters.description: Only entities whose physical address is in this state.
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Only entities that list this 6-digit NAICS code.
parameters.name: naics_code

sam_gov_registration_status_changed_trig.description: Runs when a watched SAM.gov registration changes status, such as from Active to Expired, or back when it is renewed. Each check uses one request for every 10 UEIs. Checks twice a day, to stay inside a personal key's 10 requests a day.

output.entity: The entity's registration, as SAM.gov returns it
output.exclusion_status_flag: Y if the entity has an active exclusion
output.previous_status: The registration status before the change
output.public_display_notice: SAM.gov's notice when the entity opted out of public display, else empty
output.purpose_of_registration: Purpose of registration, such as All Awards
